references.text: Verse 19 is the historical fulfillment of the criterion established in the source verse.
Verse 51 confirms that Rebekah was chosen precisely because she fulfilled the criterion in the source verse.
This is the original prayer/formulation of the criterion to which the source verse refers.
Verse 18 is the first part of the action leading up to the criterion in the source verse.
Rebekah's selection in the source verse is the concrete step toward fulfilling the promise of 'nations' given in verse 10.
Typological parallel: Both women (Abigail and Rebekah) show wisdom and humility by serving a future leader with a gift, confirming their role in God's plan.
